mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines (3-month rolling change < 0), or Rank IC over 3-year windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0% for three consecutive months, it signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and rise in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals housing sector contraction and monetary tightening, compressing corporate profit margins and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST declines and FEDFUNDS rises (3-month changes), or Rank IC over 3-year windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals manufacturing sector weakness that reduces corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods during late-cycle expansions when INDPRO declines, or Rank IC over 3-year windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential sales (RSAFS) over the past month signals strong housing demand that boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS increases (3-month rolling change > 0), or Rank IC over 3-year windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that triggers Federal Reserve tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past quarter signals robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO increases (3-month rolling change > 0), or Rank IC over 3-year windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) and decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals labor market strength with housing sector weakness, reducing consumer spending power and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: labor market strength with housing slowdown
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases and HOUST declines (3-month changes), or Rank IC over 3-year windows remains below 0.03.
